name: Power BI in Microsoft Fabric
sku: Power BI as a Fabric workload on a Fabric capacity, with Direct Lake over OneLake. On an F capacity below F64 every viewer needs a Pro or Premium Per User licence, and creating Power BI items outside My workspace always needs Pro or Premium Per User. Scored separately from the standalone power-bi record, which is the Pro tier.

serve.bi-viz.note: Connects to data sources and builds interactive charts and dashboards shared across the organisation, over all data in Fabric.

serve.semantic-layer.note: Power BI reports read OneLake through Direct Lake mode in the Analysis Services engine, which loads and refreshes large volumes of data quickly without making a copy. The model lives inside Fabric and Power BI rather than serving other tools.

bands.note: Power BI Desktop is the report-building environment, with data modelling, DAX, a performance analyzer, external tools and composite models.

presentation.tagline: Power BI on a Fabric capacity, reading OneLake directly.
